entities.name: Victor Arbekov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Mikhailovich Arbekov was a Russian Grand Prix motocross racer. He competed in the FIM Motocross World Championships from 1963 to 1968. Arbekov is notable for being the first Russian competitor to win a Motocross World Championship.
